Package neqsim.process.equipment.network

Class TwoFluidPipeNetworkRefinementStudy

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.network.TwoFluidPipeNetworkRefinementStudy
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class TwoFluidPipeNetworkRefinementStudy extends Object implements Serializable
Replays one accepted two-fluid network definition at common physical times with different outer steps, branch subcycle factors and branch spatial meshes.

The study snapshots the supplied canonical TwoFluidPipeNetwork through serialization. Every case starts from that same snapshot, changes only the outer time step, existing per-branch subcycle factors and explicitly requested section counts, and retains measured runtime, conservation residuals, node pressures and full branch profiles. A mesh override preserves length and resamples an explicit cell-face elevation route. Flat legacy elevation arrays are converted to the equivalent constant face route; non-flat legacy arrays fail closed because their section-indexed geometry cannot be changed without interpretation. The study does not change topology, boundary states, physical closures or solver tolerances. Results therefore support numerical refinement and runtime screening; they are not independent physical qualification.

1.0
Author:
Even Solbraa

    • addConfiguration

      public TwoFluidPipeNetworkRefinementStudy addConfiguration(String name, double outerTimeStepSeconds, Map<String,Integer> branchSubcycles, Map<String,Integer> branchSectionCounts)
      Add a numerical configuration with optional spatial mesh overrides.

      Omitted branches retain their captured section count. A mesh override is applied only to an independently restored case and never mutates the captured network. Explicit cell-face terrain is interpolated onto the new uniform mesh. Non-flat legacy section-indexed terrain is rejected because it cannot be reinterpreted as physical faces without a user decision.

      Parameters:
      name - unique case name
      outerTimeStepSeconds - positive outer time step in seconds
      branchSubcycles - positive integer factors keyed by branch name
      branchSectionCounts - section counts of at least two keyed by branch name
      Returns:
      this study
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - for invalid or duplicate inputs
